that--adv.def: To that degree, used before an adjective.
that--adv.ex: The film was not that long.
that--adv.exTr: Film o kadar da uzun değildi.

will--noun.def: The power to decide and act, or a legal document about your property.
will--noun.ex: He left the house to her in his will.

want--noun.def: A lack of something you need.
want--noun.ex: The plant died for want of water.

good--noun.def: Behaviour or a result that helps people.
good--noun.ex: She works for the common good.

time--verb.def: To measure how long something takes, or to choose the right moment.

say--noun.def: The right to give your opinion in a decision.
say--noun.ex: Staff had no say in the change.

need--noun.def: Something you must have, or a situation requiring action.
need--noun.ex: There is an urgent need for nurses.

down--adj.def: Feeling sad, or not working, said of a system.
down--adj.ex: The server has been down all morning.

make--noun.ex: What make is your washing machine?

very--adj.def: Used before a noun to stress that it is exactly the one.
very--adj.ex: That is the very book I wanted.

mean--noun.def: The average of a set of numbers.
mean--noun.ex: The mean of these scores is sixty.

god--noun.def: A being believed to have power over nature and people.
god--noun.ex: The ancient Greeks worshipped many gods.

wait--noun.def: A period of time spent waiting.
wait--noun.ex: We had a long wait at the border.

fine--adv.def: In a satisfactory way, used informally.
fine--adv.ex: The old engine still runs fine.
fine--adv.exTr: Eski motor hâlâ gayet iyi çalışıyor.

fine--verb.def: To make someone pay money as a punishment.
fine--verb.ex: The court fined the company heavily.
fine--verb.exTr: Mahkeme şirkete ağır para cezası kesti.

found--verb.def: To start an organization or a town.

hell--noun.def: The place of punishment after death, or a very unpleasant experience.

saw--verb.def: To cut wood or metal with a toothed blade.
saw--verb.ex: He sawed the plank in half.

since--adv.def: From a past time until now.
since--adv.ex: She left in May and has not written since.
since--adv.exTr: Mayısta ayrıldı ve o zamandan beri yazmadı.

later--adj.def: Coming after something else in time.
later--adj.ex: We will discuss it at a later date.

part--verb.def: To separate from someone, or to divide something.
part--verb.ex: They parted at the station without a word.

stuff--verb.def: To push things into a space until it is full.
stuff--verb.ex: She stuffed her clothes into a bag.

damn--adj.def: Used to show anger about something.
damn--adj.ex: The damn door will not shut.

damn--adv.def: Very, used to make a word stronger in informal speech.
damn--adv.ex: You know damn well what happened.

damn--interj.def: Said when you are annoyed or disappointed.

far--adj.def: At a great distance, or at the opposite end.
far--adj.ex: The shop is at the far end of the street.

means--noun.def: A method of doing something, or the money you have.
means--noun.ex: A bicycle is his only means of transport.

inside--adj.def: On or in the inner part of something.
inside--adj.ex: Check the inside pocket of the coat.

inside--noun.def: The inner part or surface of something.
inside--noun.ex: The inside of the box was damp.

mine--noun.def: A deep hole where coal or metal is dug out.
mine--noun.ex: His grandfather worked in a coal mine.

dear--noun.def: A kind word used when speaking to someone you like.

fire--verb.def: To dismiss someone from a job, or to shoot a weapon.

though--adv.def: However, used at the end of a sentence.
though--adv.ex: It is expensive. I want it, though.

trust--noun.def: The belief that someone is honest and reliable.
trust--noun.ex: It took years to build that trust.

question--verb.def: To ask someone questions, or to doubt something.
question--verb.ex: Police questioned him for two hours.

welcome--noun.def: The way you greet someone when they arrive.
welcome--noun.ex: They gave us a warm welcome.

cool--verb.def: To become less hot, or to make something less hot.
cool--verb.ex: Let the soup cool before serving.

free--verb.def: To let a person or an animal go.
free--verb.ex: They freed the bird from the net.

line--verb.def: To cover the inside of something, or to stand along it.
line--verb.ex: Trees line both sides of the road.

outside--adj.def: On the outer part, or coming from elsewhere.

outside--noun.def: The outer part or surface of something.
outside--noun.ex: The outside of the house needs paint.

living--noun.def: The money you earn to support yourself.
living--noun.ex: He makes a living from fishing.

cause--noun.def: An aim that people work for, or the reason something happens.
cause--noun.ex: She gave money to a good cause.

sound--adj.def: In good condition, or sensible and reliable.

win--noun.def: A victory in a game or a competition.
win--noun.ex: It was their third win this month.

hang--noun.def: The skill of doing something, learned with practice.
hang--noun.ex: You will get the hang of it soon.

sense--verb.def: To feel that something is true without being told.
sense--verb.ex: She sensed that something was wrong.

master--noun.def: A person with great skill, or one who controls others.
master--noun.ex: He is a master of the old craft.

known--adj.def: Recognized by people, or already discovered.
known--adj.ex: There is no known cure yet.

quiet--noun.def: The state of being calm and without noise.
quiet--noun.ex: She enjoys the quiet of the morning.

beat--noun.def: The regular rhythm of music or of the heart.
beat--noun.ex: The drum kept a steady beat.

darling--adj.def: Much loved, or charming in an old-fashioned way.

darling--noun.def: A person you love very much.

moving--adj.def: Causing strong feeling, or not still.

state--adj.def: Provided or controlled by the government.
state--adj.ex: She went to a state school.

state--verb.def: To say or write something clearly and formally.

chief--noun.def: The leader of a group or an organization.
chief--noun.ex: The police chief spoke to reporters.

worse--noun.def: Something more unpleasant than what came before.

round--verb.def: To go around something, or to make a number simpler.
round--verb.ex: Round the figure to the nearest ten.

rock--verb.def: To move gently back and forth, or to shock a place.
rock--verb.ex: She rocked the baby to sleep.

test--verb.def: To check how good or safe something is.
test--verb.ex: They tested the water for lead.

fear--verb.exTr: Birçok kişi topluluk önünde konuşmaktan korkar.

force--verb.def: To make someone do something they do not want to do.

present--verb.def: To give or show something formally.
present--verb.ex: She presented her findings to the board.

honor--verb.def: To show great respect for someone in public.
honor--verb.ex: The city honored its oldest teacher.

idiot--noun.def: A rude word for a person who behaves stupidly.
idiot--noun.ex: Only an idiot would drive that fast.
idiot--noun.exTr: Ancak bir aptal o kadar hızlı sürer.

deep--adj.def: Going a long way down, or strongly felt.
deep--adj.ex: He fell into a deep sleep.

major--noun.def: An army officer, or a student's main subject.

stick--noun.ex: He walked with a wooden stick.

trip--verb.def: To catch your foot and lose your balance.
trip--verb.ex: She tripped over a loose cable.

list--verb.def: To write things one after another in order.
list--verb.ex: List the ingredients on the label.

mess--verb.def: To make something dirty or untidy.
mess--verb.ex: Do not mess up the papers.

tough--adj.def: Difficult, or strong and not easily damaged.

mama--noun.def: A word for mother used by children.
mama--noun.ex: The little boy called for his mama.

bloody--adj.def: Covered in blood, or very violent.
bloody--adj.ex: It was a long and bloody war.

bloody--adv.def: Very, used for emphasis in British informal speech.
